Artwaka

A voyaging event series and collaborative platform combining contemporary Oceanic arts with intentional space for kava-talanoa — curated by NDINA Gallery.

Rooted in the shared significance of ‘waka’ — premium noble kava roots in Fijian tradition, and the traditional canoe in Māori culture — Artwaka celebrates Pacific heritage and contemporary art as a living, connected force.

Artwaka I · Auckland

Fiji Day Celebrations — Pop-Up Exhibition & Evening Artist Talanoa at Four Shells Kava Lounge

Launching during Fiji Language Week 6–10 October, Artwaka opens in Aotearoa with a pop-up exhibition at Four Shells Fale Talanoa with evening artist and artisan talanoa sessions from 6–10pm and a daytime booth at the Fiji Arts and Crafts Village in Mangere Centre Park building up to Fiji Day celebrations on October 10th.
